name: Cellar Wall Ladder v4 - Concept Fidelity
subtitle: Original low-poly concept vs scale-locked custom-topology cellar ladder
review_note: The Blender result closely follows the corrective concept: two restrained rails, nine evenly spaced rungs, one uniform aged-oak material, character-readable scale and a stronger working wall lean. The rejected wall hatch, black recess, hooks, pads, metal and lashings are all absent.
improve: Keep the rail tops touching the west wall while preserving the in-room feet and visible-mesh-only climb target.
